name: Dual Contouring (2D Grid Implementation)
definition: A method to extract a polygonal mesh from a scalar field defined on a 2D grid by placing vertices inside grid cells using Quadratic Error Function (QEF) minimization and connecting them based on edge crossings.
summary: Dual Contouring extracts a 2D mesh by placing one vertex per intersected cell using QEF minimization, yielding smoother surfaces than Marching Squares.
